intro: One number in each series breaks the pattern. Find the rule the other numbers follow; the number that doesn't fit is the answer.

tips.title: Find the rule from the numbers that agree
tips.body: Most of the series follows one rule. Work it out from the numbers that fit, then test every number against it.

tips.title: Check both sides
tips.body: A wrong number breaks the pattern twice: the gap before it and the gap after it both look odd. The number between two odd gaps is usually the wrong one.

tips.title: Try the usual rules
tips.body: Differences, ×2 ± 1, squares and cubes (n² + 1, n³ − 3, n³ + n) and two mixed series cover most questions.

tips.title: Up and down? Split the series
tips.body: If the numbers jump up and down, check the odd places and the even places separately. Each part has its own rule.

tips.title: Look inside the numbers
tips.body: If no series rule fits, look at the digits of each number. For example, in 147 and 258 the middle digit is the average of the outer two.
